# Oral-history episode: speaker cues

The episode is an eight-minute audio-only edit of three former lighthouse keepers describing one storm. All three voices are clearly recorded. The difficulty comes after edits: a listener can hear the words but sometimes forgets which keeper is speaking.

The speakers are Lena, Owen and Ravi. The original interview clips and their order stay as they are. A treatment can add material around the clips. There is no screen or printed companion for the listener.

At the first edit meeting, the producer proposed two treatments. Neither has been chosen or tried:

- Give each keeper a different chime, played when that keeper returns after another voice.
- Have the narrator say the returning keeper's name before the next clip.

The next edit meeting will audition possible treatments on the same passage. The aim is to let a listener identify the speaker after each cut without consulting anything outside the audio.
